messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.  Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
Privacy is probably not a thing of the past because regulation, anonymity, and trust norms will persist, so total disappearance remains unlikely Privacy
Consciousness copying by the early 2030s seems very unlikely because we do not yet understand subjective experience, neural dynamics, or the conditions for transfer well enough Consciousness
Wireless Internet connection anywhere is plausible in many regions, but full coverage on our planet is less likely due to cost, terrain, energy, and infrastructure Wireless
Transport electrification is very likely for cars and many commercial vehicles, but all forms eventually becoming electric is less certain because aviation and heavy freight may need alternative fuels Transport
Climate change effects are partly irreversible, but many of the worst outcomes remain avoidable, so irreversible impacts are likely though not guaranteed Climate
Physical money will probably decline, yet coins and notes may survive for decades or longer, so total disappearance is unlikely in the short term Money
Genetic secrets for extreme longevity may be uncovered, but living for centuries or forever remains highly speculative and unlikely soon Genetic
